newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTO'S LULA OUT FOR AT LEAST TWO MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO'S LULA OUT FOR AT LEAST TWO MONTHS.

text.p: Porto's Brazilian defender Luis `Lula' Marcos will be out of action for at least two months after breaking a bone in his right leg, team doctors said on Monday.
Lula, who was carried from the pitch during Porto's 0-0 home draw against Estrela da Amadora on Sunday, underwent surgery on the leg on Monday.
Porto team doctor Domingos Gomes said that the player would be unable to begin even light training for around a month and a half.
